#625 · Sword Blade Pokémon

Bisharp

Dark Steel

Unova · Generation 5

Bisharp is a Dark/Steel-type Sword Blade Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 1.6 m tall and weighs 70 kg. It evolves from Pawniard and into Kingambit. Its highest base stat is Attack (125), with a base stat total of 490.
